subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Vocabulary e.g. backpack, school, favourite, friend, teacher, classroom, uniform, pencil, learn, bus, walk, desk

show.line: Hello! Let's learn school words. Bag, pencil, desk, bus, teacher!

rounds.prompt: Who helps us learn at school?
Do we find it at school or at home? Sort the pictures.

hints: Look at the picture. Say the word with me.
A pencil is for writing. A bus takes us to school.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will name this picture.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! It is a pencil. We write with a pencil.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's look together. It is a pencil. We write with it!

parent_line: Can name school things in English: pencil, desk, bag, bus and teacher.
